ui.agents.settings.chat.not_set_yet.length_hint: Compact inline status, about 11 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.chat.not_set_yet.note: The parameter has no agent override; the backend uses its optimized default.

ui.agents.settings.chat.set_to_default.role: Button that writes a default parameter override
ui.agents.settings.chat.set_to_default.tone: Action verb; clearly says a value will be applied.
ui.agents.settings.chat.set_to_default.length_hint: Small nonshrinking button beside a parameter row; keep the label and value compact.
ui.agents.settings.chat.set_to_default.note: The click saves the displayed default for this parameter, rather than clearing it.

placeholders.value: Default value converted to its original ungrouped string (for example 0.7, 4096 or the localized chat.empty word). Appears inside parentheses; numeric values retain source punctuation in this extraction.

ui.agents.settings.chat.advanced_chat_se.note: This button expands advanced sampling, repetition and output-length controls.

ui.agents.settings.chat.advanced_setting.tone: Plain explanation for a reader unfamiliar with model settings.
ui.agents.settings.chat.advanced_setting.length_hint: Short tooltip sentence; wrapping is allowed.
ui.agents.settings.chat.advanced_setting.note: Displayed on the information control beside the expandable advanced-chat heading.

ui.agents.settings.chat.about_advanced_c.role: Accessible name of advanced-chat information button
ui.agents.settings.chat.about_advanced_c.tone: Name the information topic, not a save action.
ui.agents.settings.chat.about_advanced_c.length_hint: Screen-reader label only; no visible width limit.
ui.agents.settings.chat.about_advanced_c.note: The icon button opens the tooltip describing how response-generation settings work.

ui.agents.settings.chat.set_custom_value.role: Introductory paragraph inside expanded advanced settings
ui.agents.settings.chat.set_custom_value.length_hint: Two short sentences in a max-width prose column; wraps.
ui.agents.settings.chat.set_custom_value.note: Explain that leaving an option unset uses a tested backend default, not zero or an empty value.

ui.agents.settings.chat.sampling.note: Groups Temperature, Top P, Top K and Seed controls.

ui.agents.settings.chat.temperature.length_hint: Short inline label beside the unset status or input.
ui.agents.settings.chat.temperature.note: The numerical control changes sampling randomness, not physical temperature.

ui.agents.settings.chat.controls_randomn.tone: Technical but readable; explain the direction of the effect.
ui.agents.settings.chat.controls_randomn.length_hint: Two compact sentences beneath a control; wraps.
ui.agents.settings.chat.controls_randomn.note: Keep the range 0.0-1.0 and explain that higher settings make output more random.

ui.agents.settings.chat.top_p.tone: Established technical term; do not expand into prose.
ui.agents.settings.chat.top_p.length_hint: Very short field label, 5 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.chat.top_p.note: Names nucleus sampling: P is a parameter name, not a placeholder.

ui.agents.settings.chat.controls_cumulat.length_hint: One short sentence below a control; wraps.
ui.agents.settings.chat.controls_cumulat.note: Describes cumulative token probability and preserves the 0.0-1.0 range.

ui.agents.settings.chat.top_k.tone: Established technical term; keep K identifiable.
ui.agents.settings.chat.top_k.length_hint: Very short field label, 5 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.chat.top_k.note: Names the token-candidate limit; K is not a replacement variable.

ui.agents.settings.chat.limits_tokens_to.tone: Direct explanation of the token limit.
ui.agents.settings.chat.limits_tokens_to.length_hint: One short sentence below a control.
ui.agents.settings.chat.limits_tokens_to.note: The setting restricts candidate tokens at every generation step.

ui.agents.settings.chat.seed.note: Names a numeric random seed, not an agent name or built-in seed profile.

ui.agents.settings.chat.random_number_se.role: Help text for an unset Seed row
ui.agents.settings.chat.random_number_se.length_hint: One sentence beside the default-setting action.
ui.agents.settings.chat.random_number_se.note: Displayed when no agent seed override exists; keep its terminal period.

ui.agents.settings.chat.random_number_se.role: Description/placeholder for the editable Seed field
ui.agents.settings.chat.random_number_se.length_hint: Single-line input hint, about 52 English characters; may truncate.
ui.agents.settings.chat.random_number_se.note: The editable seed field uses the same concept as the unset row but originally has no terminal period.

ui.agents.settings.chat.repetition.note: Groups Frequency penalty and Presence penalty rather than describing an error.

ui.agents.settings.chat.frequency_penalt.length_hint: Short field label, about 17 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.chat.frequency_penalt.note: Names the penalty applied to token repetition frequency.

ui.agents.settings.chat.reduces_repetiti.tone: Explain the effect without promising repetition will disappear.
ui.agents.settings.chat.reduces_repetiti.length_hint: One sentence beneath a numerical control; wraps.
ui.agents.settings.chat.reduces_repetiti.note: Retain the -2.0 to 2.0 range; the penalty lowers the likelihood of repeated tokens.

ui.agents.settings.chat.presence_penalty.length_hint: Short field label, about 16 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.chat.presence_penalty.note: Names a distinct diversity parameter, not the frequency penalty.

ui.agents.settings.chat.increases_divers.tone: Explain token diversity in plain technical language.
ui.agents.settings.chat.increases_divers.length_hint: One sentence beneath a numerical control; wraps.
ui.agents.settings.chat.increases_divers.note: Retain -2.0 to 2.0; this sentence describes reduced likelihood of tokens from the prompt.

ui.agents.settings.chat.length_and_stopp.note: Groups Max tokens and Stop sequences.

ui.agents.settings.chat.max_tokens.length_hint: Short field label, about 10 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.chat.max_tokens.note: The limit concerns generated output tokens, not the context window size.

ui.agents.settings.chat.maximum_tokens_t.length_hint: One short sentence below the control.
ui.agents.settings.chat.maximum_tokens_t.note: Clarifies that the configured maximum bounds a generated response.

ui.agents.settings.chat.stop_sequences.length_hint: Short field label, about 14 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.chat.stop_sequences.note: Names literal text sequences that stop generation; user-entered sequences remain untranslated.

ui.agents.settings.chat.sequences_that_w.role: Help text for unset Stop sequences
ui.agents.settings.chat.sequences_that_w.tone: Explain the stopping condition without inventing a default sequence.
ui.agents.settings.chat.sequences_that_w.length_hint: One short sentence beside the default-setting action.
ui.agents.settings.chat.sequences_that_w.note: Displayed when no stop override exists; the offered default is an empty list.

ui.agents.settings.chat.empty.role: Default-value word inside the Stop sequences button
ui.agents.settings.chat.empty.tone: Lowercase value description, not an empty-state heading.
ui.agents.settings.chat.empty.length_hint: Very short word, 5 English characters; fits inside button parentheses.
ui.agents.settings.chat.empty.note: Substituted as {value} in chat.set_to_default: English renders Set to default (empty). It describes an empty stop-sequence list.

ui.agents.settings.chat.enter_stop_seque.role: Placeholder in the editable Stop sequences textarea
ui.agents.settings.chat.enter_stop_seque.length_hint: Short textarea hint; preserve the one-sequence-per-line instruction.
ui.agents.settings.chat.enter_stop_seque.note: This text is only a placeholder; sequences typed by the user are model configuration and are never translated.

ui.agents.settings.general.agent_name.length_hint: Single-line field label, about 10 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.agent_name.note: Names the agent display-name field, not its immutable ID.

ui.agents.settings.general.enter_agent_n.length_hint: Single-line input hint, about 19 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.enter_agent_n.note: Shown only when the name input has no text; preserve the ellipsis style.

ui.agents.settings.general.select_a_host.role: Tooltip for the disabled model-selection field
ui.agents.settings.general.select_a_host.note: Explains that hosting must be selected before the AI model; Automatic is a recommendation, not an identifier passed to the backend.

ui.agents.settings.general.model.note: Displayed above the disabled placeholder before a hosting provider is selected.

ui.agents.settings.general.select_a_host.tone: Brief prerequisite instruction, not an error.
ui.agents.settings.general.select_a_host.length_hint: One truncated control row, about 34 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.select_a_host.note: The model picker cannot offer choices before a hosting provider is available.

ui.agents.settings.general.agent_informa.length_hint: Single-line heading above Description, Tags and Categories.
ui.agents.settings.general.agent_informa.note: Introduces editable informational fields and the read-only metadata grid.

ui.agents.settings.general.description.length_hint: Single-line field label, about 11 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.description.note: The agent description is user-authored data; translate only this label.

ui.agents.settings.general.enter_agent_d.length_hint: Input hint, about 26 English characters; wraps with the control.
ui.agents.settings.general.enter_agent_d.note: Shown when the description field is empty; saved description text stays unchanged.

ui.agents.settings.general.tags.length_hint: Very short field label, 4 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.tags.note: Tags are user-defined metadata and not translated by this message.

ui.agents.settings.general.add_tag.length_hint: Compact entry hint, about 10 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.add_tag.note: Prompts adding one tag to the agent; no tag value is supplied by this message.

ui.agents.settings.general.categories.length_hint: Single-line field label, about 10 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.categories.note: Names the metadata editor, not the hub category filter rail.

ui.agents.settings.general.add_category.length_hint: Compact entry hint, about 15 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.add_category.note: Prompts adding one category; stored category identifiers remain unchanged.

ui.agents.settings.general.id.length_hint: Tight metadata-grid label, 2 English characters, beside an ID-card icon.
ui.agents.settings.general.id.note: The adjacent value is the immutable machine identifier; never translate that value.

ui.agents.settings.general.created.length_hint: Tight metadata-grid label, 7 English characters, beside a calendar icon.
ui.agents.settings.general.created.note: The adjacent value is the agent creation calendar date, not a relative message timestamp.

ui.agents.settings.general.version.length_hint: Tight metadata-grid label, 7 English characters, beside a branch icon.
ui.agents.settings.general.version.note: The adjacent version value comes from the agent record and remains unchanged.

ui.agents.settings.security.security_ins.length_hint: Single-line section heading beside a shield icon.
ui.agents.settings.security.security_ins.note: This editor configures the security reviewer, not the main agent system prompt.

ui.agents.settings.security.about_securi.role: Accessible name of security-instructions information button
ui.agents.settings.security.about_securi.length_hint: Screen-reader label only; no visible width constraint.
ui.agents.settings.security.about_securi.note: The information icon explains which agent receives these instructions.

ui.agents.settings.security.this_prompt_.role: Guidance paragraph above security-reviewer prompt textarea
ui.agents.settings.security.this_prompt_.tone: Concrete instructional prose; distinguish reviewer and working agent.
ui.agents.settings.security.this_prompt_.length_hint: Long paragraph in a max-width prose column; wraps freely.
ui.agents.settings.security.this_prompt_.note: Examples explain how to instruct the reviewer about allowed git operations and restricted files. Only this UI explanation is translated; the saved security prompt is not.

ui.agents.settings.security.enter_instru.length_hint: Textarea hint, about 45 English characters; wrapping allowed.
ui.agents.settings.security.enter_instru.note: Address instructions to the AI security reviewer, not the primary agent; user-entered content stays unchanged.

ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.agent_i.role: Heading above main agent system-prompt editor
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.agent_i.length_hint: Single-line section heading beside a notebook icon.
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.agent_i.note: Names the working agent instruction editor; distinguish it from security instructions.

ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.about_a.role: Accessible name of agent-instructions information button
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.about_a.length_hint: Screen-reader label only; no visible width limit.
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.about_a.note: The icon opens a tooltip defining the main agent system prompt.

ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.define_.role: Guidance paragraph above main system-prompt textarea
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.define_.tone: Helpful examples, addressed to the person configuring the agent.
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.define_.length_hint: Paragraph in a max-width prose column; wraps.
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.define_.note: Examples include an expert-researcher role and the operator name John. These are explanation examples, not defaults written into the agent prompt.

ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.loading.role: Placeholder while fetching agent system prompt
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.loading.length_hint: Short textarea loading hint, about 24 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.loading.note: Shown until the existing prompt is loaded; preserve its loading meaning so readers do not start overwriting unseen content.

ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.enter_i.role: Placeholder in loaded main system-prompt textarea
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.enter_i.note: Once loading completes, prompts entry of instructions for the working agent; stored instruction content is not translated.

ui.agents.settings.agent.no_agent_select.tone: Neutral empty state, not an error or disabled command.
ui.agents.settings.agent.no_agent_select.length_hint: Short heading beside an agent icon, about 17 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.agent.no_agent_select.note: Shown when the legacy agent-settings pane has no selected record.

ui.agents.settings.agent.select_an_agent.length_hint: One short paragraph in a centered max-width empty state; wraps.
ui.agents.settings.agent.select_an_agent.note: Tells the reader to select an agent from the list on the left to open its configuration and details.

ui.agents.settings.security.security_ins.tone: Precise explanation of the reviewer role.
ui.agents.settings.security.security_ins.note: The quoted system prompt belongs to the security agent and guides its safety decisions.

ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.system_.role: Tooltip defining main agent system prompt
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.system_.tone: Plain definition of behavior and capabilities.
ui.agents.settings.system_prompt.system_.note: Defines system prompt for the working agent, not the security reviewer.

ui.agents.settings.chat.error.invalid_se.role: Validation-error toast when saving a nonnumeric Seed
ui.agents.settings.chat.error.invalid_se.length_hint: One short toast line, about 32 English characters; wrapping allowed.
ui.agents.settings.chat.error.invalid_se.note: Shown only after attempting to save a nonempty seed value that cannot parse as a number.

ui.agents.settings.general.error.empty_n.role: Validation-error toast when saving an empty agent name
ui.agents.settings.general.error.empty_n.length_hint: One short toast line, about 26 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.error.empty_n.note: Shown when the trimmed name is empty; no save request is sent.

ui.agents.settings.chat.set_custom_value.note: Says that a blank option keeps the product's tested default.

ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.role: Field label for the agent's profile picture
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.length_hint: Single-line field label, about 15 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.note: Names the picture shown beside this agent's name in the agents sidebar. It is a mark stored on this computer, not part of the agent's definition.

ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.tone: Plain statement of a limit, not an apology.
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.length_hint: One short sentence; wrapping is allowed.
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.note: States that the picture is stored on this machine only, so it is absent on another computer or on mobile.

ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.role: Button that opens the image file picker
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.length_hint: Small button label beside the picture preview, about 12 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.note: Opens a native file picker; the chosen image is downscaled and stored locally.

ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.role: Button that forgets the stored picture
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.tone: Action verb phrase; quiet, since the default mark returns.
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.length_hint: Small ghost button label, about 12 English characters.
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.note: Shown only when a picture exists. Removing it restores the default agent mark.

ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.role: Error shown after picking an unsupported file type
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.tone: Neutral explanation with the accepted formats named.
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.length_hint: One to two sentences beside the controls; wrapping is allowed.
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.note: Triggered by SVG, PDF, a video or any non-image file. The accepted list must stay in the same order as the picker's filter.

ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.role: Error shown after picking an image above the size ceiling
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.note: The ceiling, in megabytes. Keep the number a placeholder; it is read from the constant that enforces it.

placeholders.size: Whole number of megabytes, for example 8.

ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.role: Error shown when the picked image cannot be decoded
ui.agents.settings.general.profile_pictu.note: A corrupt, truncated or mislabelled image file.
